name: expr.func_length
reason: The original fails under --ps-protocol at test line 54 (select * from a column declared int(255) zerofill): the client reports error 101 MYSQL_DATA_TRUNCATED while fetching the binary result. Not yet known whether the server's binary encoding or mysqltest's buffer sizing is at fault; candidate for a BUG(port) check. Runs normally under plain, compress and tls.

name: vector_index.vector_similarity
reason: The test sends statement text containing literal ? placeholders to assert a server error; under --ps-protocol the client itself rejects the statement first (error 2031, no data supplied for parameters), so the case cannot run in this mode by design.

name: information_schema
reason: mysqltest (obclient 2.2.12) does not apply --replace_column under --ps-protocol, so the volatile columns this test masks (TABLE_ROWS, AVG_ROW_LENGTH, DATA_LENGTH, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) leak real timestamps and the output is not repeatable; client limitation, runs normally under plain, compress and tls.
